title: Default timeoutMs of 5000 matches Bun's default per-test timeout; a real-I/O te…
body: Default timeoutMs of 5000 matches Bun's default per-test timeout; a real-I/O test calling it with defaults would race the test timeout rather than fail with the helper's own clear message. Not blocking (the story scopes callers to short values in the integration tier), but a smaller default or a doc note would make the failure mode friendlier.
